en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 3.Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Muḥammad ibn Ḥumrān, from Zurārah who said, “I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (a) say, ‘
There is no servant who commits a sin but that he is given respite from that morning until nightfall, so if he repents to Allah [within that time], it is not written against him.’”
